Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Direction: Direction the pixels are smeared: down, up, left or right.
Threshold: Luminance level (0-1) a pixel must cross to start a smear. Lower picks up darker content.
Animate: Amount of looping sinusoidal modulation of the threshold over time, so the smear start points drift. 0 = static.
Invert: Start the smear where the image becomes darker than the threshold instead of brighter.
Length: Smear length as a fraction of the frame (0-1). Scaled by the band1 modulation input.
Noise: Per-column random variation of the threshold, giving ragged, uneven smear starts. 0 = clean edge.
Streak: Amount of per-fibre length variation inside each stripe. 0 = uniform stripe length, 1 = fibrous, hairy streaks.
Grain: Film grain added over the result. 0 = none.
Bandwidth: Width in pixels of each smear stripe. 1 = per-pixel columns, larger values give chunky blocks.
Revert: Brightness of the original un-smeared image behind the streaks. 0 = black, 1 = full original.
Modamount: How strongly the modulation CHOP input (band1) scales Length. 0 = no modulation.
